notes.title: Update from November 27
notes.content:
1)Fixed bugs with music and sounds.
2) The first level with the game of hide and seek has become much easier. Now you can determine where you need to hide by tapping Tub.
3)Fixed errors with the text, now it is displayed correctly.
4) At the last level, over time, a hint appears about what exactly you need to find.
